Account.description:
An optional login attachment to exactly one person (Object Account). A person may have zero
accounts (roster-only) or one active account. `identities` are the linked login points and is
populated by getAccount/createAccount; it is empty in contexts that do not load it.

email.description: The IdP-asserted email, if any; unique among active accounts when present.

id.description: The account's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

identities.description: The external identities (login points) federated to this account.

personId.description: The URN RID of the person this account attaches to.

status.description: One of active | disabled (disable is a reversible login block).

AccountHolder.description:
The ownership edge (link__held_by). The holder is a person OR a company (polymorphic). Temporal:
an ended holding closes effectiveTo, so the edge set is the holding history.

holderLabel.description: Best-effort display label (company legal name for company holders; empty for persons).

name.description: Default-locale fallback + i18n translations.

AccreditationEvent.description: An accreditation review cycle against an institution OR a program.

ActionEndpoint.description:
The HTTP binding an action invocation targets (D-ActionInvocation, review-2026-09 R-33),
derived from the Conjure IR by tools/genactionendpoints — never hand-authored, so it cannot
drift from the contract.

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. POST, PUT, DELETE.

pathParams.description:
Path parameter names in path order. By convention the first is the target object's own
RID (the object the action runs on); any remainder are sub-resource ids the caller supplies
(e.g. the card id of a finance.card.update).

ActionParam.description:
One argument of an action type, projected from its Conjure request field (D-ActionTypes, R-29).
Descriptive only — used for discoverability (the console action catalog), not write-time
validation.

docs.description: The field's documentation from the contract, when present.

fields.description:
Present when this param is a nested object (or a list/set of one) whose own fields are all
flat — the console runner then renders a structured sub-form (or repeatable group) instead
of a raw-JSON editor (D-ActionInvocation, R-33). Emitted only **one level deep**: a nested
object that itself contains a nested object, or a self-referential type (e.g. the rank
import tree), carries no `fields` and falls back to the JSON editor. Nested field entries
are always flat, so their own `fields` is absent.

name.description: The request field name, e.g. subjectPersonId, scope.

required.description: True when the field is non-optional in the request.

sensitivity.description:
Set for a regulated/secret field (D-DataScope): `pan` (PCI card number), `iban`, `spectrum`
(special-category inference, range [-1,1]) or `secret`. The console runner masks the input
and runs the matching advisory validator; the server's pkg/personalcode validators remain
authoritative. Absent for ordinary fields.

type.description: A display type token derived from the Conjure field type, e.g. string, rid, datetime, enum, list<string>.

ActionType.description:
One registered action type (D-ActionTypes, review-2026-09 R-29): the machine catalog behind
the free-text `audit_log.action`. `code` is what an audit entry's `action` carries.

code.description: Stable dotted action code, e.g. assignment.grant, unit.transition.

endpoint.description:
The HTTP endpoint an invocation targets (D-ActionInvocation, review-2026-09 R-33),
single-sourced from the Conjure IR. Absent for actions with no invocable endpoint
(purge-cascade erasures emitted internally on PersonPurged; the bulk import.* ingestion
plane) — those are catalogued and audited but not runnable from the console.

parameters.description:
The action's argument schema (D-ActionTypes, review-2026-09 R-29 parameter-schema seam),
single-sourced from the Conjure request type that carries the action's inputs and derived
from the IR — never hand-authored. Empty for actions with no request body (deletes,
lifecycle POSTs, imports) or not yet annotated (the catalog is expand-only).

permission.description: The gating write permission (module-granular), e.g. assignment.grant, education.manage.

service.description: The owning RID service (module) name, e.g. authz, tenant, person.

targetType.description: The object type the action targets (the audit target_type), e.g. unit, person, education.

AddAccountHolderRequest.description: Add a holder (person or company) to the account; role defaults to primary.

value.description: An optional free-form belief detail; stored envelope-encrypted (pii:special).

AddCardRequest.description: Add a card to the account. The PAN is validated (Luhn), encrypted, and blind-indexed; bin/lastFour derive from it.

AddCategoryRequest.description: Add a category under a system. `name` is the default-locale text; other locales via LocalizationService.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal; defaults to (max active sibling order + 1), i.e. appended last.

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning (active) rank system.

grantedOn.description: The conferral date as a YYYY-MM-DD day string.

AddEdgeRequest.description: Attach the path unit as a child of `parentId` within a graph.

graph.description: The graph code; defaults to command.

AddEthnicityRequest.description: Declare an ethnicity for a person (self-declared, envelope-encrypted, lawful-basis-gated).

code.description: A person_ethnicity_types code (validated against the catalog before sealing).

legalBasis.description: The GDPR lawful-basis code (an Art. 9 condition; platform_legal_basis_kinds).

AddGraphRequest.description: Add a graph (instance-admin; graph.manage). Per-org when orgId is set, else instance-global (M40).

orgId.description: The organization the new graph belongs to; omit for an instance-global/cross-org graph.

code.description: ISO 639-3 code; must be unique.

AddManufacturerRequest.description: Record that a company manufactures this brand (temporal).

AddNameAliasRequest.description: Add an alias name form (aka/former_legal/maiden/pseudonym/cover). Addressed by its RID; may carry attribution.

variantKind.description: One of aka | former_legal | maiden | pseudonym | cover.

AddRankRequest.description: Add a rank under a (leaf) type.

gradeCode.description: Optional standardized cross-system grade (a GET /rank-grades code); validated on write.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal; defaults to appended last within the type.

typeId.description: The URN RID of the owning (active) type.

AddSystemRequest.description: Add a rank system (the top level). `name` is the default-locale text; other locales via LocalizationService.

country.description: Country RID of the national origin (resolve via GET /geo/countries); omit for a supranational system (NATO/UN).

sortOrder.description: Order among active systems; defaults to appended last.

AddTypeRequest.description:
Add a type, rooted either directly under a category (categoryId) or nested under a parent
type (parentTypeId — it then inherits the parent's category). Supply exactly one; a parent
type that already holds ranks cannot gain child types (ranks live on leaf types only).

categoryId.description: The URN RID of the owning (active) category, for a root type. Omit when nesting under a parent type.

parentTypeId.description: The URN RID of the owning (active) parent type, for a nested type. Omit for a root type.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal; defaults to appended last among the new type's active siblings.

Address.description:
A person's precise, effective-dated address (D-PersonAddresses, M32) — a reified link to a
shared location_locations row (M19 Location). Distinct from Residence (country-grade legal
residence); an Address is the geocoded overlay. pii:contact; purge-erased.

isPrimary.description: The person's primary address (at most one active primary per person).

locationId.description: The location_locations RID this address resolves to (create/resolve via the location service).

privacySeeking.description: A mailing address that deliberately differs from home (itself a signal).

role.description: One of home | work | mailing | other.

validFrom.description: ISO-8601 date the address became effective.

validTo.description: ISO-8601 date the address ended; null = current.

Affiliation.description:
A reified person↔religion lay-affiliation link (link__affiliated_with). GDPR Art. 9 pii:special:
the optional free-form `value` belief detail is envelope-encrypted at rest (D-SpecialPII) and
returned decrypted to authorized readers (empty once crypto-erased on person purge). The
structural anchors (faith/tradition/community/type) are plain references.

value.description: The decrypted free-form belief detail (pii:special); null when unset or crypto-erased.

AffiliationType.description: A per-tradition lay-affiliation / milestone type (adherent/member; baptized; shahada; …).

Alias.description: A search-only alternative name for an org unit (never displayed).

Appointment.description: A person filling an education position (link__holds_education_position), one-holder, effective-dated.

Assignment.description:
The reified link__has_role — the unit of granted authority. graphId is null for unit scope
and names the cascade graph for subtree scope. Reversible: revoking sets revokedAt rather
than deleting.

expiresAt.description: Optional decision-time expiry; null = no expiry.

grantedBy.description: The granting person RID; null for the install bootstrap grant.

graphId.description: The cascade graph RID (subtree only); null for unit scope.

id.description: The assignment's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

AssignmentPage.description: A page of assignments plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

Association.description: A symmetric association / conflict-of-interest / prohibited-contact link (D-PersonRelationships; Link link__associated_with).

personIdA.description: The lower-sorting person's URN RID (canonical pair ordering).

AuditActorType.description: The two actor kinds (D-Audit). An instance admin is a PERSON, never a separate kind.

AuditEntry.description: One immutable audit record — who did what to which target, when, in which request.

action.description: The action code, e.g. assignment.grant, unit.transition, rank.scheme.update.

actorPersonId.description: The person who acted; present iff actorType is PERSON.

after.description: State snapshot / change payload after the change (no secrets; PII minimized).

before.description: State snapshot before the change (no secrets; PII minimized).

id.description: The Action RID (action__<type>) this entry records; the audit log is the action ledger.

requestId.description: Correlation key shared with logs, metrics, and traces.

subsystem.description: Originating source for SYSTEM actions (bootstrap, event-subscriber, …); present iff actorType is SYSTEM.

targetType.description: The acted-on entity kind, e.g. unit, person, role_assignment, account, graph.

unitId.description: The unit context of the action where applicable (drives scoped audit reads).

AuditEntryPage.description: A page of audit entries plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

AuditOutcome.description: Outcome of the recorded action; denied write attempts are recorded too (D-Audit).

AuthorizeQuery.description: One question in a batch decision.

AuthorizeRequest.description: Ask the PDP whether subject may perform action on unit. unitId is omitted for instance-scope actions.

explain.description: When true, the response carries an explanation (DS-16). Default false.

AuthorizeResponse.description: A PDP decision. explanation is present only when explain was requested.

BatchAuthorizeRequest.description: Several questions for one subject; the subject's authority state is fetched once.

Beneficiary.description: A natural person who is the ultimate beneficial owner of a company (link__beneficiary_of, UBO).

declared.description: Whether the ultimate ownership is registry-declared (vs computed).

Branch.description: A non-independent sub-unit BRANCH_OF a parent company (link__branch_of).

Brand.description: A vehicle marque (Toyota/BMW…); countryId is the country of origin (nullable).

Building.description: A physical building of an institution (optionally a unit), located via the shared M19 location.

kind.description: One of academic | dormitory | administrative | library | sports | other.

locationId.description: The shared location RID (M19); null until geocoded.

CallSign.description: A person's informal identifier / позивний (D-PersonContactChannels). pii:basic; unique per person among active.

callSign.description: The call sign label (required; unique per person).

isPrimary.description: The person's primary call sign (at most one active).

CanonicalEnvelope.description:
The interchange document hermenea produces and oikumenea upserts. `objectType` must equal the
path object-type. `records` are object-type-specific JSON objects the registered handler reads.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the upstream snapshot was generated (lineage only).

isLast.description:
True on the final chunk of a chunked run; triggers the object-type's batch
finalizers (e.g. the languoid closure + family_code rebuild). The final chunk may
carry zero records (a pure finalize marker).

license.description: License/attribution string carried for lineage (not persisted per-row).

objectType.description: The importable object-type key (e.g. geo-countries); must match the path parameter.

records.description: The object-type-specific records to upsert; each is a JSON object.

seq.description:
1-based chunk index within a chunked run. Chunks are sent sequentially and each is
applied in its own transaction; replaying a chunk is safe (every record apply is a
natural-key idempotent upsert). Absent (with runId/isLast absent) = a single-shot
envelope, the pre-chunking semantics.

source.description: Stable source identifier (e.g. iso-3166) — stamped as row provenance.

sourceVersion.description: The source's version/edition (e.g. 2024) — stamped as row provenance.

Card.description:
A payment card contained by exactly one account. The full PAN is envelope-encrypted; `pan` is
populated (decrypted) only on getCard for authorized callers. bin (first 6) + lastFour are the
display-only clear digits, always returned. No CVV exists.

cardholderPersonId.description: An optional named cardholder (a person RID), independent of the account's holders.

pan.description: The decrypted PAN; present only on getCard for authorized callers.

Citizenship.description: A person's effective-dated nationality in a country (D-Geo). A person may hold several; at most one active per country.

acquiredOn.description: ISO-8601 date the citizenship was acquired.

basis.description: How the citizenship was acquired — one of birth | descent | naturalization | other.

isPrimary.description: The person's primary nationality (at most one active).

lostOn.description: ISO-8601 date the citizenship was lost; null = currently held.

Classification.description: A religion-type ("theism") classification (monotheistic/polytheistic/…), tagged onto taxa/units.

ClergyCredential.description:
A reified person↔religion ordination/standing link (link__clergy_credential). A PUBLIC directory
fact, never an authorization input (parallel to D-Rank). Indelible where sacramental — revocation
is a status flip (active|suspended|revoked), never a hard delete.

grantedOn.description: The date the standing was conferred, as a YYYY-MM-DD day string.

orgUnitId.description: The organization unit that conferred/recognizes the standing.

ClergyGrade.description: An ordered, per-tradition clergy grade. ordinal orders ONLY within a tradition (no cross-tradition comparator).

ClosureReport.description: The result of a closure verify/rebuild for one graph (D-ClosureIntegrity / D-ClosureDriftHealth).

extraCount.description: Spurious stored closure rows the recompute did not produce.

graph.description: The graph code this report covers.

missingCount.description: Closure rows the recompute found missing vs. the stored closure.

sample.description: Optional small drift sample for diagnostics.

ClosureReportList.description: Per-graph closure reports (one per graph processed).

domain.description: The palette this color belongs to — eye | hair | vehicle.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

Company.description: A legal entity at registry grade. Soft-deleted, not destroyed.

ownershipCategory.description: One of private | public | state_owned | municipal | foreign | mixed.

CompanyLocation.description: A company's address, located via the shared M19 location; role distinguishes registered/operating/branch.

CompanyPosition.description:
A company-owned billet (CEO/director/employee line; mirrors membership Position) — exists while
vacant; carries no authority. The current holder is populated on get/list (null when vacant).

Contribution.description: One reason an ALLOW was reached. instanceAdmin true means the instance plane; otherwise the assignment is named.

CoordinateInput.description:
A coordinate in one of several supported formats. The application converts it to a canonical
WGS84 lat/lon, derives the MGRS, and preserves this input verbatim as the location's
sourceCoordinate. `format` selects which fields are read (the others are ignored); the
converter set is a pluggable registry, so more formats can be added without a schema change.

format.description: One of latlon | mgrs | utm | sk42 | sk42grid.

CoordinateResolution.description: The reverse-geocode of a coordinate — the containing country plus the nearest place. Either may be absent if the gazetteer has no coverage at the point.

country.description: The country whose shape contains the point (or, lacking a shape, the nearest place's country); absent if neither resolves.

place.description: The nearest gazetteer place; absent only if the gazetteer is empty.

Country.description: A country in the ISO-3166-1 registry. `id` is the RID (the reference key); `code` is the stable ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 lookup code; `name` is the locale->text display name.

code.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. UA, PL); the stable, locale-agnostic lookup key.

id.description: The country's RID (location service); what person/document/rank reference.

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; default-locale `name` column + i18n store, keyed by country code).

Course.description: A unit of study / module / subject of an institution (optionally a unit).

CreateAccountRequest.description:
Create an account for a person, optionally linking its first external identity in the same
operation. The first identity on a new account is always permitted (the linking cap applies
only to ADDITIONAL identities).

identity.description: The first login point to link; omit to create a login-less account shell.

CreateChildOrgRequest.description:
Create a child religious-body unit under a parent in the canonical graph (a tenant unit + the
parent→child canonical edge + the child's profile + an optional primary classification).
Rejected with Religion:ChildCreationExcluded if the parent carries an excludes_child_creation policy.

CreateDocumentRequest.description: Attach a paper to a person. The type and (optional) issuing country are validated against their registries.

CreateDocumentTypeRequest.description: Add a document (paper) type to the catalog.

attrSchema.description: Optional per-type attribute schema (D-DocumentAttrSchema); validated on document write when set.

name.description: Default-locale label; translatable via the localization store.

CreateDomainRequest.description: Add an org-kind domain to the catalog (instance-admin; domain.manage).

CreateExternalOrgRequest.description:
Register an external organization. status defaults to resolved; pass provisional to create a
stub awaiting merge. source/confidence default to operator_verified/possible when omitted.

CreateMembershipRequest.description: Add a person's belonging to a unit, optionally filling a position. The position (if given) must belong to the unit.

effectiveFrom.description: When the membership takes effect; defaults to now.

orderItemId.description: Optional provenance pointer to the authorizing order item (D-Orders).

positionId.description: The position to fill; omit for plain belonging.

CreateOrderRequest.description: Create a draft order for an issuing unit, with its items (≥1).

CreateOrderTypeRequest.description: Add an order type to the catalog.

category.description: One of personnel-list | appointment | leave-travel | discipline-incentive | duty-roster.

effect.description: One of membership-start | membership-end | rank-change | record-only.

name.description: Default-locale label; translatable via the localization store.

CreateOrganizationRequest.description:
Create an organization (the realm). Seeds its `command` (default, locked authority-bearing,
undeletable) + `operational` graphs in the same transaction (D-TenantOrganizations, M40).

CreatePersonRequest.description: Create a person — no account and no unit required (L-AccountOptional / D-PersonGlobal).

sex.description: ISO/IEC 5218 value; defaults to not_known when omitted.

CreatePersonalCodeRequest.description: Attach a national-identifier code to a person. The value is validated against the scheme then encrypted.

value.description: The plaintext identifier (pii:sensitive). Validated against the scheme, then stored as ciphertext + blind index.

CreatePersonalCodeSchemeRequest.description: Add a national-identifier scheme to the catalog.

name.description: Default-locale label; translatable via the localization store.

CreatePositionRequest.description: Create a billet in a unit (vacant). The title is the default-locale fallback; additional locales are set via LocalizationService.

title.description: The default-locale title (the i18n fallback); translatable separately.

CreateProvisionalPersonRequest.description:
Create a provisional stub person (D-OverlayFoundation, M29). Minimal-PII: only a display name
is required, with optional attribution (source/confidence) recording how the stub was learned.

confidence.description: Certainty weight — confirmed | probable | possible (defaults to possible).

source.description: How the stub was learned — self_declared | operator_verified | imported (the attribution convention).

CreateRoleRequest.description: Create a custom role. name/description are the default-locale fallbacks (translatable separately).

permissions.description: Permission codes from the catalog; instance-scope and unknown codes are rejected.

CreateRootOrgRequest.description:
Create a top-level religious body (M41 / D-UnifiedOrgGraph): a `church`-domain
tenant organization + its root religious-body unit + the unit's profile + an optional primary
classification. The body has no parent (no canonical edge); descendants are added via
createChildOrg. `code`/`name` apply to both the organization and its root unit.

CreateScheduleRequest.description: A recurring service time — supply dayOfWeek (0=Sunday…6=Saturday) OR an rrule. meetingUrl is required when mode is online/hybrid.

publicPrecision.description: exact | street | neighborhood | city | hidden (default exact).

parentId.description: The parent taxon; omit for a root religion.

CreateUnitKindRequest.description: Add a domain-scoped unit kind (instance-admin; unit-kind.manage).

CreateUnitRequest.description: Create a unit. `name` is the default-locale text; other locales are managed via LocalizationService.

code.description: Optional human-readable code (omit for a non-separate sub-unit; D-UnitCodeLifecycle, M28).

domainId.description: The unit's domain RID; defaults to the organization's domain when omitted. May differ (mixed trees).

kindId.description: The unit's domain-scoped unit-kind RID (replaces free-text unitKind). Must belong to the unit's domain.

orgId.description: The owning organization's RID (required; D-TenantOrganizations, M40).

attributes.description: A JSON object string; defaults to {}.

CryptoWallet.description:
A crypto-wallet attribution for a person (D-PersonOverlays, M35) — an Object. The address is
public on-chain data, but attributing it to a person is pii:sensitive; synergy with the M34
sanctioned-wallet cross-check. Hard-erased on purge.

attributionMethod.description: One of exchange_kyc | blockchain_analysis | self_declared | leak | public_post | other.

chain.description: One of bitcoin | ethereum | solana | tron | bnb | polygon | monero | other.

CurriculumItem.description: A course placed in a curriculum version (required/elective + credit/year metadata).

CurriculumVersion.description: A versioned snapshot of a program's requirements.

DeactivateRequest.description: Begin reversible deactivation; opens a grace window (purgeAfter = now + the configured grace).

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit entry.

DegreeLevel.description: An ISCED 2011 degree level (0..8), a migration-seeded reference scale.

DiscoverySite.description:
A public discovery hit: a site with its coordinate coarsened per publicPrecision (latitude/
longitude are null when the precision is `hidden`).

DistinguishingMark.description: A tattoo/scar/piercing/birthmark (D-PhysicalIdentity, M31). pii:special ceiling — a mark can reveal Art. 9 data.

bodyLocation.description: Where on the body (e.g. left forearm); free text.

kind.description: One of tattoo | scar | piercing | birthmark.

Document.description: A person-held paper of some type — metadata only (no binaries). number/issuer are pii:basic.

attributes.description: Free-form long-tail per-type fields (JSONB). pii:special ceiling.

id.description: The document's URN RID.

issuedOn.description: ISO-8601 date the document was issued.

issuingCountry.description: Country RID of the issuing country (resolve via GET /geo/countries); lets one person hold same-type papers from several countries.

number.description: The document number (passport no., licence no.). pii:basic.

status.description: One of active | superseded | revoked — self-asserted, reversible, orthogonal to deletion.

DocumentPage.description: A page of documents plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

DocumentType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a PAPER kind (passport, driver-license). Stable code + translatable name.

attrSchema.description:
Optional per-type attribute schema (D-DocumentAttrSchema): when set, a document's
`attributes` is validated against it on write. Shape:
{ "fields": { "<name>": { "type": "string|number|boolean|date", "required": bool, "enum": [...]? } } }.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

id.description: The document type's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

Domain.description:
An org-kind catalog row (D-TenantOrganizations, M40): military/government/company/
university/church/public-org, … Classifies organizations and units; a directory attribute,
never a PDP input. `code` is the stable external reference; `name` is the locale->text map.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (e.g. military, university). Immutable by convention.

id.description: The domain's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

DomainList.description: The domain (org-kind) catalog, in display order.

DormitoryStay.description: A person RESIDED_IN_DORMITORY — a dedicated stay (person ↔ dorm building, room, period).

EducationPosition.description:
An institution/unit-owned billet (mirrors membership Position) — exists while vacant; carries
no authority. The current holder is populated on get/list (null when vacant).

EducationUnit.description: A node in an institution's recursive structure tree (campus → faculty → department → chair).

depth.description: Distance from the queried root (populated by list-by-institution via the closure).

parentId.description: The parent unit RID; null for a top-level unit.

EffectiveType.description: A unit's resolved religion-type, with the source that supplied it (nearest-declared-wins).

Email.description: A person's contact email (D-PersonContactChannels). pii:contact; distinct from the login email.

isPrimary.description: The person's primary email (at most one active).

provider.description: Provider derived from the address domain on write (gmail.com -> google); null when no mapping.

typeCode.description: The email-type catalog code (personal | work | other ...).

EmailType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a contact-email kind. Stable code + translatable name.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

EndMembershipRequest.description: End a membership, vacating any filled billet (reversible status flip + effectiveTo).

effectiveTo.description: When the membership ended; defaults to now.

orderItemId.description: Optional provenance pointer to the authorizing order item (D-Orders).

Enrollment.description: A person STUDIED_AT an institution (optionally a unit/group), with an ISCED level + qualification.

programId.description: The program studied (education_programs); null if unspecified.

status.description: One of enrolled | graduated | withdrawn | expelled | on_leave.

Ethnicity.description:
A person's self-declared ethnicity (D-PhysicalIdentity / D-SpecialPII, M31). The declared value
is envelope-encrypted at rest; `code` is the DECRYPTED catalog code returned only to authorized
readers. A crypto-erased tombstone returns an empty code.

code.description: The declared ethnicity-type code (decrypted); empty for a crypto-erased tombstone.

legalBasis.description: The GDPR lawful-basis code (platform_legal_basis_kinds; an Art. 9 condition for special-category data).

name.description: The catalog's default-locale display name for the declared code.

EthnicityType.description:
A declared-ethnicity vocabulary entry in an instance-admin-managed, HIERARCHICAL taxonomy
(D-PhysicalIdentity amendment, M43). Stable code + translatable name + optional parent (tree
structure). `languages`/`countries` are GROUP-level ethnolinguistic + homeland associations
(reference metadata about the group; NEVER a person's datum — a person's ethnicity and
languages stay independent). This catalog is plaintext; a person's SELECTION is encrypted.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code).

countries.description: Homeland-country RIDs (geo_countries) — group-level, populated on getEthnicityType.

hasChildren.description: Whether this group has children (lets a tree browser show the expand affordance).

languages.description: Associated-language RIDs (Glottolog languoids) — group-level, populated on getEthnicityType.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

parentId.description: The RID of the immediate parent group (absent for forest roots).

wikidataId.description: Wikidata Q-id anchor (external linkage; from the opt-in import).

Explanation.description: Why a decision was reached. For ALLOW, the contributing grants (may be several across graphs); for DENY, the reason.

ExternalIdentity.description:
A verified (issuer, subject) login point federating to one account (Object External
identity). Globally unique; immutable once created and removed by unlink. No token columns —
access/refresh tokens are never persisted.

accountId.description: The URN RID of the account this identity federates to.

id.description: The external identity's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

subject.description: The IdP `sub` — a pseudonymous identifier for the person.

name.description: Default-locale fallback + i18n translations.

ExternalOrganization.description:
An external organization at registry grade. Soft-deleted, not destroyed. The RID is the
external handle. Carries the D-OverlayFoundation provisional/resolved status + attribution.

name.description: Default-locale fallback + i18n translations.

wikidataId.description: Optional Wikidata Q-id concordance (the hermenea import natural key).

ExternalReference.description:
An off-platform pointer about a person (D-InstitutionalTies, M33) — an Object. Mirrors a social
account; a hermenea import target (idempotent by URL). pii:basic.

kind.description: One of wikipedia | news | registry | social | court | academic | other.

FillPositionRequest.description: Fill a vacant position with a person (a membership referencing the position; its unit is the position's unit).

Founding.description: Who FOUNDED a company (link__founded). The founder is a person or a company (polymorphic holder).

holderLabel.description: Best-effort display label (company legal name for company holders; empty for persons).

GovernanceBody.description: A board / senate / council / committee of an institution.

GovernanceMembership.description: A person is a member of a governance body.

GovernmentPosition.description:
A public office a person holds or held (D-InstitutionalTies, M33) — a reified link. pepTrigger
persists after the position ends and feeds the M34 PEP watchlist check. pii:basic.

body.description: The government body, e.g. "Ministry of Defence", "US Senate".

level.description: One of international | national | regional | local.

orgId.description: Optional resolved body RID (polymorphic — external org / company / unit).

pepTrigger.description: Politically-exposed-person flag; persists after the office ends.

GradeCategory.description: A per-tradition grouping of clergy grades (e.g. Christianity → major/minor orders).

traditionTaxonId.description: The tradition taxon this category is scoped to; null = generic across faiths.

Grant.description: A funding grant held by an institution.

GrantAssignmentRequest.description: Grant a role to a person at a target unit. graph applies to subtree scope (default command); ignored for unit.

graph.description: The cascade graph CODE for a subtree grant; omit to default to the command graph. Ignored for unit scope.

GrantHolding.description: A person holds a grant (PI / co-investigator / researcher).

GrantInstanceAdminRequest.description: Place a person on the instance-admin plane.

Graph.description: A named hierarchy over the units (D-Graphs), per organization (M40). Each graph is independently a DAG.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (e.g. command, operational); unique per org (or among global graphs); referenced by edges/closure/assignments.

id.description: The graph's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

isAuthorityBearing.description: Whether the PDP cascades subtree grants over this graph (D-DirectoryGraphs). command is locked TRUE.

isDefault.description: The graph a subtree grant uses when none is named; exactly one default exists (seeded command).

name.description: locale->text display name.

orgId.description: The owning organization's RID (D-TenantOrganizations, M40); ABSENT = an instance-global/cross-org graph (e.g. religion's taxonomy graphs).

GraphList.description: The graph registry, in display order.

Group.description: A cohort (study group) under a unit, with an admission year.

Guardianship.description: A legal guardian→ward link, distinct from blood kinship (D-PersonRelationships; Link link__guardian_of).

ImportRankSchemeRequest.description:
A preset rank-system subtree to import (D-RankSystems): one system with its categories ->
types (a tree) -> ranks, each carrying a stable `code`. Applied as a code-keyed idempotent
upsert in one transaction (additive; never deletes).

ImportRankSchemeResponse.description: How many scheme nodes the import created, updated, or skipped (already current).

ImportResult.description: The per-object-type outcome of one idempotent upsert.

skipped.description: Rows already up to date (idempotent no-ops).

ImportSource.description: A registered external dataset hermenea can sync into oikumenea.

ImportType.description: A type node; carry EITHER children OR ranks (ranks live on leaf types only).

children.description: Nested child types; empty for a leaf type.

ranks.description: Ranks on this (leaf) type; empty for a non-leaf type.

IndustryAssignment.description: A company's economic-activity classification (M:N), one primary + secondaries.

InstanceAdmin.description: A person on the instance-wide authority plane (the reified link__instance_admin).

grantedBy.description: The granting person RID; null for the install bootstrap grant.

id.description: The grant's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

Institution.description: An external reference institution (where people studied/taught). Soft-deleted, not destroyed.

countryId.description: The institution's country RID (geo_countries); null for international/online.

InstitutionKind.description: An instance-admin catalog entry classifying an institution (university/school/…).

name.description: Default-locale fallback + i18n translations.

IssuerOption.description:
One IdP issuer accepted by this instance (from install config), offered to binding UIs so an
operator picks an issuer rather than typing it. PUBLIC fields only — verification secrets
(HS256 keys) are never exposed. An external identity's `issuer` must match one of these for a
token from it to ever validate.

audience.description: The expected `aud`, if the instance pins one.

issuer.description: The `iss` value (also the OIDC discovery base URL).

type.description: One of oidc | hs256 (hs256 is local/dev only).

JobRef.description: A reference to an enqueued worker job (the result of a sync trigger).

Kinship.description: A directional parent→child blood/legal parentage link (D-PersonRelationships; Link link__kin_parent_of). Siblings are derived, never stored.

Languoid.description: A node in the Glottolog forest. `id` is the RID (the reference key); `code` is the stable glottocode; `name` is the locale->text display map.

code.description: Glottocode (8-char), the stable, locale-agnostic lookup key (e.g. stan1293).

familyCode.description: The root-family glottocode (derived via the closure).

hasChildren.description: Whether this languoid has non-dialect children (family/language); lets a tree browser show an expand affordance only on expandable nodes.

id.description: The languoid's RID (language service); what person/unit/locale links reference.

iso6393.description: ISO 639-3 code, when the languoid has one (families/dialects usually do not).

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; default-locale `name` column + i18n store).

parentId.description: The RID of the immediate parent languoid (absent for a top-level family / isolate).

LanguoidList.description: A page of languoids in code order.

nextPageToken.description:
Keyset cursor (the last glottocode on this page) to fetch the next page; absent when the
page is the last one. Pass it back as `pageToken`. The filters must be held constant across
a paged sweep.

LegalBasisKind.description:
A structured GDPR lawful basis (D-OverlayFoundation, M29) — an Article 6 lawful basis or an
Article 9 special-category condition. Referenced by FK from every future pii:special overlay
store; the `code` is the stable handle.

LegalForm.description: A per-country legal form (ТОВ/ПАТ/ФОП, LLC/JSC/GmbH …); countryId null for a generic form.

name.description: Default-locale fallback + i18n translations.

LinkGroup.description: All links of one type + direction incident to the queried object.

linkType.description: The bare link-type name from the pkg/rid registry (e.g. member_of, kin_parent_of).

targetType.description: The neighbor object type all rows in this group point at.

LinkIdentityRequest.description: Link a verified (issuer, subject) login point to an account.

LinkRow.description: One reified link incident to the queried object, type-erased to what every link shares.

attrs.description: Optional link attributes chosen by the descriptor (status, role, effective dates, …).

direction.description: out (queried object is the source end), in (the target end), or peer (symmetric link).

linkRid.description: The reified link's own RID (kind=link; self-describes which link type this is).

targetLabel.description: Best-effort neighbor display name as a locale→text map (D-i18n: all locales in every response, no negotiation); absent ⇒ the client falls back to the RID tail. Resolved server-side by the neighbor type's registered labeler.

targetRid.description: The neighbor object's RID at the other end of the link (canonical UUID text).

targetType.description: The ontology registry token for the neighbor's type (person, unit, organization, …).

LobbyingRelationship.description:
A public lobbying filing (D-InstitutionalTies, M33) — a reified link: the person as registrant
lobbying for a client before a legislative body on a set of issues. pii:basic.

Locale.description: A supported language for the deployment. `code` is the stable ISO 639-3 identifier; `name` is the endonym.

code.description: ISO 639-3 code (e.g. ukr, eng); the stable, locale-agnostic identifier.

isDefault.description: Exactly one enabled locale is the default; its value is the fallback when a translation is absent.

name.description: Endonym/display name (e.g. "Українська", "English").

LocaleLanguage.description:
A supported locale's canonical Glottolog language (D-Languages, M18; Link link__locale_language).
Read-only: the link is reconciled by the language-scheme import (matching the locale's ISO-639-3
code to a languoid's iso639_3), not edited directly.

name.description: The languoid's translatable display name as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

LocaleList.description: The supported locales, in display order.

Location.description: A shared place — a precise coordinate, an app-derived MGRS, and a structured postal address.

countryId.description: The country's RID (resolve an ISO alpha-2 code via GET /geo/countries).

id.description: The location's RID (location service); what owning modules reference by FK.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude of the authoritative coordinate.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude of the authoritative coordinate.

mgrs.description: App-derived MGRS grid reference (absent for polar UPS coordinates, out of scope).

sourceCoordinate.description: The coordinate as originally supplied (its format + raw values), preserved verbatim.

typeName.description: Localized name (locale->text) of the place type, when typeId is set.

LocationPage.description: A page of locations plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

LocationType.description: An instance-admin catalog label classifying a place (building/address/online); descriptive only.

name.description: Localized display name (locale->text), all enabled locales.

LocationTypeList.description: The active location types, in display order.

LocationWrite.description:
Create/replace payload for a location. `coordinate` is the required spine (validated in the
application, not the wire, so a missing/unparseable coordinate returns Location:CoordinateRequired
or Location:CoordinateInvalid rather than a deserialization error). MGRS is never supplied — it
is app-derived from the resolved WGS84 coordinate.

coordinate.description: The coordinate in any supported format; required (absence → Location:CoordinateRequired).

Manufacturer.description: A brand is MANUFACTURED_BY a company (link__manufactured_by); temporal (changes with acquisitions).

Membership.description:
A person's belonging to a unit (the reified link__member_of), effective-dated, optionally
filling a position. A position-less membership is plain belonging. Reversible: ending flips
status and sets effectiveTo rather than deleting, vacating any filled billet.

effectiveTo.description: When the membership ended; null while active.

id.description: The membership's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

orderItemId.description: Provenance — the order (наказ) item that authorized this fill/belonging (D-Orders); null when created without an order.

personId.description: The URN RID of the person who belongs / fills.

positionId.description: The URN RID of the position this membership fills; null for plain belonging.

unitId.description: The URN RID of the unit belonged to.

MembershipPage.description: A page of memberships plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

MergeExternalOrgRequest.description:
Resolve a provisional stub into a canonical organization. The provisional org (the path id) is
tombstoned; the canonical (intoOrgId) survives. confidence is recorded on the merge action.

MergePersonRequest.description: Resolve a provisional stub into a canonical person (D-OverlayFoundation, M29).

confidence.description: Operator certainty about the identity equation — confirmed | probable | possible (defaults to possible). Recorded in the audit trail.

intoPersonId.description: The URN RID of the surviving canonical person the stub's edges are re-homed onto.

MessengerLink.description:
Reachability on a messenger platform over one of the person's existing channels
(D-PersonSocialChannels). Exactly one of phoneId/emailId is set.

emailId.description: The URN RID of the person's email this link annotates; null when the link is over a phone.

isPrimary.description: The person's primary messenger reachability (at most one active).

phoneId.description: The URN RID of the person's phone this link annotates; null when the link is over an email.

verifiedAt.description: When the reachability was verified; null when unverified.

Model.description: A model under a brand (containment); generation + the manufacture window are structural specs.

NameVariant.description: A full transliterated name form for one locale (e.g. ukr native, eng Latin). Person-managed, NOT the localization store.

confidence.description: Alias attribution confidence weight (confirmed | probable | possible).

locale.description: The locale/script this form is for (an i18n_locales code).

source.description: Alias attribution — how the name was learned (self_declared | operator_verified | imported); null for transliterations.

variantKind.description: transliteration (the canonical per-locale form) | aka | former_legal | maiden | pseudonym | cover (D-PhysicalIdentity).

NearestPlace.description: The gazetteer place nearest a coordinate (D-GeoPlaces) — a city/town/village (placetype=locality) when one exists, else the nearest county/region. Powers the locations-form prefill.

countryId.description: The RID of the containing country.

distanceMeters.description: Great-circle distance in metres from the input coordinate to the place's centroid.

id.description: The place's RID (location service).

name.description: Default-locale display name; other locales arrive via the i18n store.

Neighborhood.description:
The queried object's depth-1 neighborhood as a flat neighbor list — the graph-explorer
shape (search-around). Depth>1 is a deliberate non-goal for this endpoint (review-2026-09).

NextOfKin.description: An in-directory next-of-kin nomination (subject→contact, both directory persons; D-PersonRelationships; Link link__next_of_kin). A nomination, not a blood fact.

contactId.description: The nominated contact's URN RID (an in-directory person).

priority.description: Priority ordering of the nomination (1 = highest).

ObjectHistory.description:
A paginated, reverse-chronological history of one object, read from the audit ledger
(D-Temporal tier b, R-31). Serves the "what did this record say / who changed it when"
question a Gotham-style dossier timeline needs.

redacted.description:
True when this response withheld before/after payloads because the caller lacks the
sensitive-reader capability. The timeline itself is unaffected.

rid.description: The object RID whose history this is (the audit target_id filter).

ObjectHistoryEvent.description:
One dated change in an object's history (D-Temporal, review-2026-09 R-31): a projection of an
audit row keyed to this object's RID. `before`/`after` carry the change payload and are
**redacted (null) unless the caller holds the sensitive-reader capability** — the timeline
(when/what/who) is always visible under `audit.read`.

action.description: The action code that produced the change, e.g. person.rank.assign, unit.transition.

actorPersonId.description: The person who acted; present iff actorType is PERSON.

after.description: State after the change; null when redacted (caller lacks sensitive-reader) or absent.

at.description: When the change was recorded (the audit row's createdAt).

before.description: State before the change; null when redacted (caller lacks sensitive-reader) or absent.

requestId.description: Correlation key shared with logs, metrics, and traces.

subsystem.description: Originating source for SYSTEM actions; present iff actorType is SYSTEM.

targetType.description: The acted-on entity kind (the audit target_type), e.g. person, unit.

ObjectLinks.description: The queried object's links, grouped by (link type, direction) in fixed order.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque composite keyset token; absent when every selected link arm is exhausted.

rid.description: Echo of the queried object RID.

OfficeType.description: A clergy office-type label (offices themselves are filled as membership Positions).

Order.description: An order header (наказ) plus its items. Mutable while draft; locked on issue.

id.description: The order's URN RID.

issuingUnitId.description: The unit that issues the order (NOT NULL — no instance-level orders); anchors unit-scope authz.

items.description: The order's items (≥1). Returned on get/create/issue/revoke; empty on list pages.

number.description: The order number (unique within its issuing unit).

revokedByOrderId.description: The later order that revoked this one (set on revoke).

OrderItem.description: One affected person/act within an order. Parent-scoped — no lifecycle of its own.

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 date the act takes effect (legal metadata, not a scheduler trigger).

effectiveTo.description: ISO-8601 date the act ceases effect.

id.description: The order item's URN RID.

note.description: Free-text detail (reason, reference). pii:basic — minimized, no secrets.

positionId.description: Target billet RID (appoint/dismiss); per the type's effect.

rankId.description: Target rank RID (rank-change); per the type's effect.

typeId.description: The order type's URN RID (its effect drives the required target columns).

unitId.description: Target unit RID (arrival/transfer/appointment); per the type's effect.

OrderItemInput.description: One item in a create/edit request. Which targets are required is validated against the type's effect.

OrderPage.description: A page of orders plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted). Items are omitted on list rows.

OrderType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming an order kind (arrival, appoint, leave-annual). Stable code + translatable name, with a category and an effect.

category.description: One of personnel-list | appointment | leave-travel | discipline-incentive | duty-roster.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

effect.description: The downstream consequence — one of membership-start | membership-end | rank-change | record-only.

id.description: The order type's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

OrgClassification.description: A tradition tag on a unit (link__classified_as), one of which may be primary.

OrgKind.description: A descriptive organizational-level label for a religious-body unit (never branched on).

religionId.description: The religion taxon this kind is scoped to; null = generic across faiths.

OrgPolicy.description: A data-driven eligibility/exclusion rule on a unit.

OrgProfile.description: The 1:1 faith attributes of a religious-body unit, with its classification tags.

Organization.description:
The realm a person joins (D-TenantOrganizations, M40): US Army / Bundeswehr / KhNU. Many
organizations may share a domain. Owns units and per-org graphs. A directory attribute,
never a PDP input — authority flows only through its graphs.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code; NOT NULL UNIQUE, immutable by convention).

id.description: The organization's URN RID.

name.description: locale->text display name.

OrganizationPage.description: A page of organizations plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

OwnershipGraph.description: The ownership/affiliation neighbourhood of one company (one hop in each direction).

holdings.description: Stakes this company holds in OTHER companies (subsidiaries via the ownership DAG).

successions.description: Lineage where this company is the predecessor or the successor.

Partnership.description:
A marriage or engagement between two persons (D-PersonRelationships; Link link__partnered_with).
Symmetric: stored as a canonical pair (personIdA < personIdB). At most one active engaged/married
row per person.

effectiveTo.description: ISO-8601 date it ended (YYYY-MM-DD); null = ongoing.

personIdA.description: The lower-sorting partner's URN RID (canonical pair ordering).

status.description: One of engaged | married | divorced | widowed | annulled | dissolved.

PartyMembership.description:
A person's political-party affiliation (D-InstitutionalTies, M33) — a reified link. Political
opinion is a GDPR Art. 9 special category, so the party identity is envelope-encrypted at rest;
`party` here is the decrypted value ("" for a crypto-erased tombstone). legalBasis is required.
pii:special.

legalBasis.description: The platform_legal_basis_kinds code authorizing this Art. 9 processing.

party.description: The party name (or an external-organizations RID). Decrypted; "" when crypto-erased.

role.description: One of member | official | candidate | donor | supporter | other.

validTo.description: ISO-8601 date the affiliation ended; null = current.

Person.description:
An individual personnel record. Names follow the Unicode CLDR fixed field set
(D-PersonNamesCLDR): displayName is authoritative, the structured parts are advisory. There
is no patronymic field — the Slavic по-батькові lives in given2. nameVariants/citizenships/
residences are populated by getPerson and empty in list responses.

attributes.description: Free-form long-tail directory fields (JSONB). pii:special ceiling — no special-category data without the envelope seam.

birthdate.description: ISO-8601 calendar date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD); a day, not an instant.

callSigns.description: The person's call signs. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

citizenships.description: The person's citizenships. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

code.description: Optional stable, locale-agnostic external id (e.g. personnel/service number); unique among active persons.

countryOfBirth.description: Country RID (resolve via GET /geo/countries), validated against the geo registry (D-Geo).

dateOfDeath.description: ISO-8601 calendar date of death (YYYY-MM-DD); a bio attribute, not a lifecycle state — a deceased person stays an active record (D-PersonBio).

displayName.description: The canonical full name form; authoritative for search/display.

emails.description: The person's contact emails. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

given2.description: Second given name; also holds the Slavic по-батькові / Icelandic patronymic.

id.description: The person's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

messengerLinks.description: The person's messenger reachability links. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

nameVariants.description: Locale-tagged transliterations. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

phones.description: The person's contact phones. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

purgeAfter.description: End of the reversibility window; purge is refused before it.

ranks.description: The ranks the person holds — at most one per rank system (a DIRECTORY attribute; never an authz input — D-Rank). Empty when unranked. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

residences.description: The person's residence history. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

sex.description: Biological sex, ISO/IEC 5218 as text — one of not_known | male | female | not_applicable.

socialAccounts.description: The person's standalone social accounts. Populated by getPerson; empty in list responses.

status.description: Lifecycle status — one of active | deactivated | purged | provisional (D-OverlayFoundation).

surnamePrefix.description: Nobiliary / genealogical particle (van, von, de, bin).

PersonAccount.description: An account a person holds, enriched with the bank + the person's holding role (read-only).

role.description: The person's holding role on this account (primary | joint | authorized_signer).

PersonAppointment.description: An appointment a person holds, enriched with the position's title and owning institution (read-only person view).

PersonCompanyAffiliations.description: A person's company links — employment, founding, ownership, and ultimate-beneficiary records.

PersonCompanyAppointment.description: A company appointment a person holds, enriched with the position title + owning company (read-only).

PersonLanguage.description:
A language a person speaks (D-Languages, M18; Link link__speaks). languageId references a
level='language' Glottolog languoid (LanguageService); name is the languoid's translatable
display name (locale -> text map). cefrLevel is the optional CEFR proficiency; isNative flags a
mother tongue.

cefrLevel.description: CEFR proficiency — one of A1 | A2 | B1 | B2 | C1 | C2; null when unstated.

isNative.description: Whether this is a mother tongue.

languageId.description: The languoid's URN RID (a level='language' node; resolve via GET /language/v1/languages).

name.description: The languoid's translatable display name as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

PersonPage.description: A page of persons plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

PersonRank.description: One rank a person holds, scoped to a rank system (the HOLDS_RANK link; one per system — D-Rank). A directory attribute, never an authz input.

rankId.description: The URN RID of the rank held in that system.

systemId.description: The URN RID of the rank system (derived from the rank); clients resolve the label via RankService.

PersonVehicleRegistration.description: A vehicle registration a person owns, enriched with the vehicle's identity (read-only).

PersonVehicles.description: A person's vehicle registrations (current + historical, newest first).

PersonalCode.description: A person-held government identifier of some scheme. Its value is pii:sensitive — stored encrypted, returned decrypted here.

id.description: The personal code's URN RID.

schemeCode.description: The scheme this code belongs to (its country derives from the scheme).

value.description: The decrypted national-identifier value (pii:sensitive). Reading it is a sensitive action gated by personal-code.read.

PersonalCodeScheme.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a country-namespaced national-identifier scheme (ua-rnokpp, us-ssn).

code.description: The scheme id (D-Code); the natural key. Immutable by convention.

countryIso.description: Country RID of the scheme's country (resolve via GET /geo/countries; the field name is retained for compatibility).

genericCategory.description: Semantic grouping — one of tax-id | national-id | social-insurance | health-insurance | residence-permit | other.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (D-i18n).

validationRegex.description: Optional data-side fallback format check (a compiled validator takes precedence).

Personality.description:
A declared or formally-assessed personality profile (D-PersonOverlays, M35) — an Object.
DECLARED SURVEY OR FORMAL HR ASSESSMENT ONLY — never inferred from text. pii:sensitive.

framework.description: One of mbti | big_five | disc | enneagram | other.

method.description: One of self_declared_survey | hr_assessment (inference is forbidden).

result.description: The typed output, e.g. "INTJ", a Big-Five summary, an Enneagram type.

Phone.description: A person's contact phone (D-PersonContactChannels). number is E.164-normalized; country is derived. pii:contact.

country.description: Country RID derived from the number (resolve codes via GET /geo/countries); null when underivable.

isPrimary.description: The person's primary phone (at most one active).

number.description: The phone number, E.164-normalized on write.

typeCode.description: The phone-type catalog code (mobile | home | work | other ...).

PhoneType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a contact-phone kind. Stable code + translatable name.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

PhysicalDescription.description: An effective-dated physical description (D-PhysicalIdentity, M31). pii:basic.

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 date the description took effect.

effectiveTo.description: ISO-8601 date it ceased; null = current.

eyeColorId.description: Eye color — a platform_colors RID (domain='eye', D-Color). Resolve label/hex via the platform color catalog.

hairColorId.description: Hair color — a platform_colors RID (domain='hair', D-Color). Resolve label/hex via the platform color catalog.

Place.description: An administrative place in the WOF geo_places gazetteer (D-GeoPlaces). `id` is the RID; used e.g. as a vehicle plate region (placetype=region).

countryId.description: The RID of the containing country.

id.description: The place's RID (location service); what consumers (e.g. vehicle registrations) reference.

name.description: Default-locale display name; other locales arrive via the i18n store.

PlaceList.description: The places matching the query, in name order.

Platform.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a social network / messenger (D-PersonSocialChannels). Stable code + translatable name + category.

category.description: One of messenger | social. Only messenger platforms may carry a messenger link.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

Policy.description: An institutional rule/regulation (optionally approved by a governance body).

PoliticalLeaning.description:
An INFERRED political leaning (D-PersonOverlays, M35) — an Object. Political opinion is a GDPR
Art. 9 special category, so `spectrum` is envelope-encrypted at rest; the value here is decrypted
(0 for a crypto-erased tombstone). legalBasis is required. This is a SEPARATE overlay and is NEVER
merged with the declared M33 party membership. pii:special.

inferenceSources.description: The inference methodology tags, e.g. social_media | voting_record | donation_records.

legalBasis.description: The platform_legal_basis_kinds code authorizing this Art. 9 inference.

spectrum.description: The inferred left/right position in [-1,1]. Decrypted; 0 when crypto-erased.

Position.description:
A unit-owned billet (D-Position) — an Object that exists whether or not anyone fills it (a
VACANCY is an active position with no active filling). Position grants no authority. The
current holder is populated by getPosition and by listPositions (null when vacant).

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier, unique within the unit; immutable by convention.

holder.description: The current active filling, if any. Populated by getPosition and listPositions; null when vacant.

id.description: The position's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

requiredRankId.description: Optional advisory establishment rank (a rank RID); never enforced against any filler.

sortOrder.description: App-managed display order within the unit.

status.description: One of active | abolished (abolish is a reversible status flip).

title.description: The billet title as a locale -> text map (default-locale fallback + i18n translations).

unitId.description: The URN RID of the owning unit.

PositionPage.description: A page of positions plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

Program.description: A degree/diploma/certificate program of an institution (optionally a unit).

Publication.description: An academic publication (optionally tied to an institution).

Qualification.description: A formally awardable qualification (degree) classification of an institution.

QualificationAward.description: A person was awarded a qualification (the diploma award).

Rank.description: A specific grade within a type (e.g. sergeant, associate_professor), ordered for exact seniority.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); unique within its type among active ranks.

gradeCode.description:
Optional standardized cross-system grade (NATO STANAG 2116; one of the GET /rank-grades
codes). Two ranks are equivalent across systems when they share a gradeCode; absent => no
cross-system comparison.

id.description: The rank's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; default-locale fallback + i18n store).

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active siblings within the type (lower = more junior).

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system (denormalized; equals the type's system).

typeId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank type.

RankCategory.description: A branch within a rank system (e.g. army, navy; or academic, administrative), ordered.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; unique among active categories within the system.

id.description: The category's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active categories of the system.

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system.

types.description: The category's types in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the category.

RankGrade.description:
A standardized cross-system comparability node (NATO STANAG 2116): the seeded reference catalog
two ranks compare through. Equivalence = same code; seniority = tier then ordinal.

code.description: STANAG 2116 grade code (e.g. OF-5, OR-9, OF(D)).

name.description: Generic, nation-neutral grade label (not translatable; grades are reference data, not i18n entities).

tier.description: One of officer | warrant | enlisted (enlisted < warrant < officer for cross-tier seniority).

RankScheme.description: The whole scheme, systems -> categories -> types -> ranks, each level in seniority order.

RankSystem.description:
The top level of the scheme (D-RankSystems): a national/organizational rank ladder. One scheme
may hold several at once (a coalition directory); a single-nation deployment has one.

categories.description: The system's categories in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the system.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (e.g. us-armed-forces); unique among active systems.

country.description: Country RID of the national origin (resolve via GET /geo/countries); absent for a supranational system (NATO/UN).

id.description: The system's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

RankType.description:
A band within a category (e.g. officers, warrant, enlisted), ordered. Types form a TREE: a
type may nest under another type of the same category (parentTypeId), and ranks attach to
LEAF types only.

categoryId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank category (the root category; carried on every type in the tree).

children.description: Child types in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty for a leaf type and on create/update.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; unique among active siblings (same category + parent).

id.description: The type's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

parentTypeId.description: The URN RID of the parent type; absent for a root type of the category.

ranks.description: The type's ranks in seniority order (leaf types only). Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the type.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active siblings (within the parent type, or the category for a root type).

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system (denormalized; equals the category's system).

RecordBranchRequest.description: Record that the given branch company is a branch of this company (the parent).

RecordFoundingRequest.description: Record a founder of this company (person or company holder).

RecordShareholdingRequest.description: Record a stake held in this company (person or company holder).

RecordSuccessionRequest.description: Record that this company (the predecessor) is succeeded by the given successor.

RegisterVehicleRequest.description:
Register the vehicle to a new owner (person or company). Any currently-active registration for
the vehicle is closed first (registration is the ownership history), so this also performs a
transfer. subdivisionId (the plate region) must be a geo_places region when supplied.

Registration.description:
The ownership+plate record (link__registered_to). The owner is a person OR a company
(polymorphic). country/subdivision carry the registering country + optional plate region. A
re-registration is a new row (the prior closed), so registration IS the ownership history.

ownerLabel.description: Best-effort display label (company legal name for company owners; empty for persons).

subdivisionId.description: The plate region — a geo_places RID (placetype=region).

RegistrationScheme.description: A registration-identifier scheme (LEI/DUNS/EDRPOU/VAT/EIN); isGlobal marks the worldwide spine.

RegulatorySanction.description:
A structured regulatory/enforcement action against a person (D-Watchlists, M34) — an Object.
Durable reference data (operator-curated or hermenea-imported), distinct from the volatile
live-lookup above. Idempotent import keys on (person, externalId). pii:sensitive.

actionType.description: One of fine | ban | license_revocation | warning | settlement | debarment | other.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code; required when amount is present.

externalId.description: The id within the source system (the import idempotency key).

status.description: One of active | appealed | overturned | expired | settled.

RelationType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry for an open-ended person↔person relation label (D-PersonRelationships). Stable code + translatable name + category.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

ReparentTaxonRequest.description: Move a taxon under a new parent, recomputing the closure. Cycle-guarded.

parentId.description: The new parent taxon; null makes the taxon a root religion.

ReparentUnitRequest.description: Move a unit under a new parent (same institution), recomputing the closure. Cycle-guarded.

parentId.description: The new parent unit; null makes the unit top-level.

ResearchCentre.description: A research centre / institute / lab of an institution.

ResearchGroup.description: A research cluster under a centre and/or unit of an institution.

ResearchMembership.description: A person is a member of a research group.

Residence.description: A person's effective-dated residence in a country/region (D-Geo). Locator data (pii:contact).

validTo.description: ISO-8601 date the residence ended; null = current.

RevokeOrderRequest.description: Revoke an issued order. The optional revoking order's RID is recorded as revoked_by_order_id.

Role.description: A named set of permission codes (Object Role). Base roles are seeded and immutable.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; immutable by convention.

description.description: The role description as a locale -> text map; empty when unset.

id.description: The role's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

isBase.description: True for seeded base roles (immutable by instance admins).

name.description: The role name as a locale -> text map (default-locale fallback + i18n translations).

permissions.description: The role's permission codes (the closed catalog; code-defined).

RolePage.description: A page of roles plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

Scholarship.description: A financial award scheme (institution or external).

ScholarshipAward.description: A person was awarded a scholarship.

SearchHit.description: One matched object, type-erased down to what every object shares.

label.description: Primary display line (person display name, catalog name, organization name, …).

objectType.description: The ontology registry token for the hit's type (e.g. person, languoid, company).

rid.description: The object's RID (canonical UUID text; self-describes service/kind/type).

snippet.description: Optional secondary line (code, MGRS, title detail) — provider-chosen.

SearchResultPage.description: Hits grouped by object type in fixed lexicographic type order.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque composite keyset token; absent when every selected provider is exhausted.

SerializableError.description: The Conjure error envelope returned on any non-2xx response.

errorCode.description: Coarse category, e.g. NOT_FOUND, INVALID_ARGUMENT, PERMISSION_DENIED, CONFLICT, FAILED_PRECONDITION.

ServiceSchedule.description: A per-site recurring service time (a weekly day or an RRULE subset).

timezone.description: IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Kyiv), not a UTC offset.

SetClassificationsRequest.description: Replace the set of classification tags (theism) on a taxon or unit, by classification id.

SetOrgProfileRequest.description: Create or update a unit's religion profile (faith-body attributes).

SetRankRequest.description:
Set or clear the person's rank in ONE rank system (one rank per system — D-Rank). The rank's
system is derived from the rank itself, so on set only rankId is needed; on clear, systemId
names the system to clear.

rankId.description: The URN RID of the rank to assign (its rank system is derived); omit to clear the person's rank in `systemId`.

systemId.description: Required only when clearing (rankId omitted) — the URN RID of the rank system to clear. Ignored when rankId is present.

SetUnitCodeRequest.description:
Set, correct, or clear a unit's code (D-UnitCodeLifecycle, M28). An omitted `code` CLEARS the
code (the unit becomes a non-separate sub-unit). `reason` is recorded on the append-only ledger.

code.description: The new code; omit to clear the code (NULL). Must be unique among active coded units.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the code-change ledger.

Shareholding.description: A holder OWNS_STAKE in a company (link__owns_stake). Polymorphic holder; company-holder edges form the ownership DAG.

Site.description:
A worship-community unit's place: the reified link__site_of (Unit ↔ a shared Location,
D-Location). latitude/longitude carry the EXACT coordinate, returned to authorized owners; the
discovery search coarsens them per publicPrecision.

publicPrecision.description: exact | street | neighborhood | city | hidden — the app-side publish-precision projection.

SocialAccount.description:
A person's standalone social-network account (D-PersonSocialChannels). platformUserId is the
platform's immutable internal id (the durable key); handle is the mutable current @handle.

confidence.description: Weight of the claim — one of confirmed | probable | possible.

handle.description: The current @handle (mutable; rename history kept separately).

isPrimary.description: The person's primary social account (at most one active).

platformCode.description: The platform code the account is on.

platformUserId.description: The platform's immutable internal id (the durable key); null when unknown.

platformVerified.description: The platform "blue-check"; distinct from operator confirmation.

profileUrl.description: Profile URL; derived from platform + handle on write when not supplied.

source.description: How the account was learned — one of self_declared | operator_verified | imported.

verifiedByOperatorAt.description: When an operator confirmed the account; null when unconfirmed.

SocialAccountHandle.description: One period in a social account's @handle-rename history (D-PersonSocialChannels). validTo null = current.

validTo.description: When this handle stopped being current; null = current.

Sponsorship.description: A sponsor→sponsored link — godparent / academic advisor / military mentor (D-PersonRelationships; Link link__sponsor_of).

educationRole.description: Optional education role of the sponsor — one of professor | tutor | curator | advisor.

enrollmentId.description: Optional education context — the enrollment (D-Education, M20) this sponsorship relates to.

Succession.description: M&A / reorganization lineage — predecessor SUCCEEDED_BY successor (link__succeeded_by).

kind.description: One of merger | reorganization | rename | acquisition | spinoff.

Taxon.description: A node in the recursive faith taxonomy. parentId is null for a root religion.

depth.description: Distance from the queried/root ancestor (populated by list/search via the closure).

religionId.description: The denormalized root religion taxon (derived via the closure).

TaxonRank.description: An ordered structural level in the taxonomy scaffold (religion → branch → … → denomination).

Unit.description: A node in the org graph. `code` is the stable external reference; `name` is the locale->text map.

code.description: Optional human-readable business ID (D-UnitCodeLifecycle, M28); absent = a non-separate sub-unit. The RID (id) is the stable external handle. Unique among active units that have a code; set/corrected/cleared via PUT /units/{id}/code.

domainId.description: The unit's domain (kind class) RID; defaults to the org's domain, may differ (mixed trees). Never a PDP input.

id.description: The unit's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

kindId.description: The unit's domain-scoped unit-kind RID (replaces the former free-text unitKind). Never branched on in code.

level.description: Optional ordinal for sort/filter; never a PDP or shadow-gate input.

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; default-locale fallback + i18n store).

UnitCodeEvent.description: One entry in a unit's append-only code-change ledger (D-UnitCodeLifecycle, M28).

id.description: The event's URN RID.

newCode.description: The code after the change (absent = the code was cleared).

oldCode.description: The code before the change (absent = the unit was codeless).

UnitCodeEventList.description: A unit's code-change history, newest first.
