UnitEdge.description: A directed parent->child relationship within one graph (link__parent_of).

graph.description: The graph code this edge belongs to.

id.description: The edge's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

UnitKind.description:
A domain-scoped unit-kind catalog row (D-TenantOrganizations, M40) replacing the former
free-text unitKind (military→brigade/battalion/platoon; university→faculty/department/chair).

attrSchema.description: Optional JSON schema validating a unit's metadata for this kind.

code.description: Stable identifier, unique among active kinds of the same domain.

domainId.description: The owning domain's RID; codes are unique per domain.

id.description: The unit-kind's URN RID.

name.description: locale->text display name.

UnitKindList.description: The unit-kind catalog for a domain, in display order.

UnitLanguage.description:
A unit's official/working language (D-Languages, M18; Link link__unit_language). languageId
references a Glottolog languoid (LanguageService); name is its translatable display name.

isOfficial.description: Whether the language is official (vs. merely working) for the unit.

languageId.description: The languoid's URN RID (resolve via GET /language/v1/languages).

name.description: The languoid's translatable display name as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

UnitPage.description: A page of units plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

UnitRef.description: A lightweight unit reference with its closure depth (ancestor/descendant listings).

code.description: Optional human-readable code (absent for a codeless sub-unit; D-UnitCodeLifecycle).

depth.description: Closure distance from the queried unit (shortest path in the DAG).

UnitRefList.description: An ordered list of unit references (ancestors), nearest first.

UnitRefPage.description: A page of unit references (descendants) plus the opaque next-page token.

UnitState.description:
A unit's (or organization's) lifecycle state. Transitions are reversible and recorded as
append-only events. Organizations reuse this enum (D-TenantOrganizations, M40).

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Update currency/accountTypeId/status and optionally re-key the IBAN; omitted fields are unchanged.

UpdateAffiliationRequest.description: Flip status (active|lapsed|renounced) and/or re-encrypt a new belief value.

UpdateCardRequest.description: Update network/type/expiry/cardholder/status; omitted fields are unchanged. The PAN is not re-keyed here.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Edit/reorder a category. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable by convention.

UpdateClergyCredentialRequest.description: Flip status (active|suspended|revoked) and/or set effective-dating. Never a hard delete.

UpdateCompanyRequest.description: Update name/form/category/country/dates/state. code is immutable; omitted fields are unchanged.

UpdateDocumentTypeRequest.description: Edit a document type. `code` is immutable by convention.

attrSchema.description: Replace the per-type attribute schema (D-DocumentAttrSchema). Omitted leaves it unchanged.

UpdateDomainRequest.description: Rename / retire a domain. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable.

UpdateEthnicityRequest.description: Re-declare the ethnicity value and/or flip legal basis / status.

UpdateGraphRequest.description: Rename / set default / flip isAuthorityBearing (guarded). Omitted fields are unchanged.

isDefault.description: Setting true makes this the sole default; the previous default is cleared in the same transaction.

UpdateInstitutionRequest.description: Update name/kind/country/dates/state. code is immutable; omitted fields are unchanged.

UpdateLocaleRequest.description: Enable/disable, rename, set default, or reorder a locale (instance-admin; `locale.manage`). Omitted fields are unchanged.

isDefault.description: Setting true makes this the sole default; the previous default is cleared in the same transaction.

UpdateOrderRequest.description: Edit a draft order. Omitted scalar fields are unchanged; when `items` is present it REPLACES the draft's items. Rejected once issued.

UpdateOrderTypeRequest.description: Edit an order type. `code`, `category`, and `effect` are immutable by convention.

UpdateOrganizationRequest.description: Update name/domain/metadata/visibility. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable; state is changed via PUT /organizations/{id}/state.

UpdatePersonRequest.description:
Update a person's names (canonical + CLDR parts), birthdate, date_of_death, sex,
country_of_birth, and attributes. Omitted fields are unchanged; an empty string clears an
optional name part. `code` is immutable by convention and ranks are set via setRank (per system).

UpdatePersonalCodeRequest.description: Update a personal code's value (re-validated + re-encrypted) and/or status. Omitted fields are unchanged.

UpdatePersonalCodeSchemeRequest.description: Edit a scheme. `code` is immutable by convention.

UpdatePositionRequest.description: Update a position's title / required rank / sort order. `code` and unit are immutable. Omitted fields are unchanged.

requiredRankId.description: Set the advisory required rank; omitted leaves it unchanged (clearing it is an open seam).

UpdateRankRequest.description: Edit/reorder a rank. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable; `gradeCode` cannot be cleared (open seam).

UpdateRoleRequest.description: Update a custom role's name/description and (when present) replace its permission set. code/isBase immutable.

permissions.description: When present, fully replaces the permission set. Omit to leave permissions unchanged.

UpdateSiteRequest.description: Patch a site's type/visibility/precision/primary flag. Promoting to primary clears any existing primary.

UpdateSystemRequest.description: Edit/reorder a system. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable; `country` cannot be cleared (open seam).

UpdateTaxonRequest.description: Update name/rank/description/wikidata/sort. code and parent are changed via reparent only.

UpdateTypeRequest.description: Edit/reorder a type. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable.

UpdateUnitKindRequest.description: Rename / retire a unit kind or adjust its attr schema. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code`/`domainId` are immutable.

UpdateUnitRequest.description: Update name/kind/domain/level/metadata/visibility. Omitted fields are unchanged. `code` is excluded — set it via PUT /units/{id}/code (D-UnitCodeLifecycle). `orgId` is immutable.

domainId.description: Re-classify the unit's domain (mixed trees allowed). The kind, if set, must match.

UpsertAccountTypeRequest.description: Create/update (by code) an account-type catalog entry. name is the default-locale fallback.

UpsertAddressRequest.description: Add an address, or replace one when id is supplied (D-PersonAddresses, M32).

id.description: The RID of an existing address row to replace; omit to add a new row.

locationId.description: The location_locations RID this address resolves to.

role.description: One of home | work | mailing | other.

validFrom.description: ISO-8601 date the address became effective; defaults to today.

UpsertAssociationRequest.description: Record or replace a symmetric association between the path person and counterpartId.

UpsertCallSignRequest.description: Add a call sign, or replace one when id is supplied. The value is required and unique per person.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing call-sign row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertCatalogKindRequest.description: Create/update an institution-kind or unit-kind. name is the default-locale fallback.

UpsertCitizenshipRequest.description: Add or replace the active citizenship for a country (keyed by (person, country)).

basis.description: birth | descent | naturalization | other; defaults to other.

UpsertColorRequest.description: Add or update a color (instance-admin; `color.manage`). Upserts on (domain, code).

name.description: The default-locale display name (other locales arrive via the localization store).

UpsertCryptoWalletRequest.description: Add a crypto wallet, or replace one when id is supplied (D-PersonOverlays, M35).

UpsertDistinguishingMarkRequest.description: Add a distinguishing mark, or replace one when id is supplied.

id.description: The RID of an existing mark row to replace; omit to add a new row.

kind.description: One of tattoo | scar | piercing | birthmark.

UpsertEmailRequest.description: Add a contact email, or replace one when id is supplied. provider is derived from the address.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing email row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertEnrollmentRequest.description: Create or update a person's enrollment. On create, omit nothing required; on update, target by id.

UpsertEthnicityTypeRequest.description: Add or update a declared-ethnicity catalog entry (instance-admin managed).

name.description: The default-locale display name (other locales arrive via the localization store).

parentId.description: The RID of the parent group (absent for a root). D-PhysicalIdentity amendment, M43.

UpsertExternalOrgKindRequest.description: Create/update (by code) an external-org-kind catalog entry. name is the default-locale fallback.

UpsertExternalReferenceRequest.description: Add an external reference (idempotent by url), or replace one when id is supplied (M33).

lastChecked.description: RFC-3339 timestamp of the last verification check.

UpsertGovernmentPositionRequest.description: Add a government position, or replace one when id is supplied (D-InstitutionalTies, M33).

UpsertGuardianshipRequest.description: Record or replace a guardian→ward link between the path person and counterpartId; role names the path person's side.

role.description: The path person's role — guardian | ward.

UpsertIndustryClassRequest.description: Create/update (by code) an industry-class catalog entry.

UpsertKinshipRequest.description: Record or replace a parent→child kinship between the path person and counterpartId; role names the path person's side.

role.description: The path person's role — parent | child.

UpsertLegalBasisKindRequest.description: Add or update a lawful-basis catalog entry (instance-admin).

UpsertLegalFormRequest.description: Create/update (by code) a legal-form catalog entry. name is the default-locale fallback.

UpsertLobbyingRelationshipRequest.description: Add a lobbying relationship, or replace one when id is supplied (D-InstitutionalTies, M33).

UpsertMessengerLinkRequest.description:
Add a messenger link over one of the person's phones or emails, or replace one when id is
supplied. Exactly one of phoneId/emailId must be set; platformCode must be a messenger platform.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing messenger-link row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertNameVariantRequest.description: Add or replace the name variant for a locale (keyed by (person, locale)).

UpsertNextOfKinRequest.description: Nominate or replace a next-of-kin contact for the path person (the subject). contactId must be an in-directory person.

contactId.description: The nominated contact's URN RID (an in-directory person).

UpsertPartnershipRequest.description:
Record or replace a partnership between the path person and partnerId. The pair is stored in
canonical order; the path person must not be the partner. At most one active engaged/married
partnership per person.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing partnership row to replace; omit to add a new row.

partnerId.description: The other partner's URN RID (an in-directory person).

status.description: engaged | married | divorced | widowed | annulled | dissolved.

UpsertPartyMembershipRequest.description: Add a party membership, or replace one when id is supplied (D-InstitutionalTies, M33).

UpsertPersonLanguageRequest.description: Add or update a language the person speaks (keyed on languageId). cefrLevel/isNative are the proficiency attributes.

cefrLevel.description: A1 | A2 | B1 | B2 | C1 | C2; omit to leave unstated.

languageId.description: The languoid's URN RID; must resolve to a level='language' Glottolog node.

UpsertPersonalityRequest.description: Add a personality profile, or replace one when id is supplied (D-PersonOverlays, M35).

UpsertPhoneRequest.description: Add a contact phone, or replace one when id is supplied. number is E.164-normalized and country derived.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing phone row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertPhysicalDescriptionRequest.description: Add a physical description, or replace one when id is supplied.

effectiveFrom.description: ISO-8601 date; defaults to today on insert.

id.description: The RID of an existing description row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertPoliticalLeaningRequest.description:
Set the person's inferred political leaning (replaces the single active row). Requires legalBasis
(Art. 9). Inferred-only — never a declared party affiliation (D-PersonOverlays, M35).

UpsertRegulatorySanctionRequest.description: Add a regulatory sanction, or replace one when id is supplied (D-Watchlists, M34).

UpsertResidenceRequest.description: Add a residence row, or replace one when id is supplied.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing residence row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertSchemeRequest.description: Create/update (by code) a registration-scheme catalog entry.

UpsertSocialAccountRequest.description: Add a social account, or replace one when id is supplied. handle is normalized and profileUrl derived when omitted.

confidence.description: confirmed | probable | possible; defaults to possible.

id.description: The URN RID of an existing social-account row to replace; omit to add a new row.

UpsertSponsorshipRequest.description: Record or replace a sponsor→sponsored link between the path person and counterpartId; role names the path person's side. relationCode is required (category=sponsorship).

educationRole.description: Optional sponsor education role — one of professor | tutor | curator | advisor.

enrollmentId.description: Optional education context — the enrollment (D-Education, M20) this sponsorship relates to.

role.description: The path person's role — sponsor | sponsored.

UpsertUnitLanguageRequest.description: Add or update a unit's official/working language (keyed on languageId).

isOfficial.description: Defaults to true (official); false marks a working language.

UpsertVehicleTypeRequest.description: Create/update (by code) a vehicle-type catalog node. name is the default-locale fallback.

Vehicle.description: A physical vehicle at registry grade. Soft-deleted, not destroyed. The RID is the external handle.

attributes.description: Long-tail spec grab-bag as a JSON string (DS-53 will column-ize stabilized fields).

brandId.description: The brand of the model (derived), when a model is set.

a fully-unscoped listing is rejected with Tenant:UnitInvalid. Optionally filtered by
`domain` (cross-cut within the org, for mixed trees), `unitKind`, and `level`. Token-paginated.

For hierarchical (expand-on-click) browsing in graph `graph` (default `command`): pass
`rootsOnly=true` to list only the org's top-level units (those with no parent in the graph),
or `parent=<unitRid>` to list a unit's DIRECT children in the graph. The two are mutually
exclusive, and each ignores the `domain`/`unitKind`/`level` filters. When neither is set the
listing is the flat, filtered org listing.

parameters.description: REQUIRED — the organization RID to scope the listing to.
parameters.name: org

parameters.description: Optional domain RID filter (units of this kind within the org). Ignored when `parent`/`rootsOnly` is set.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Optional unit-kind RID filter. Ignored when `parent`/`rootsOnly` is set.
parameters.name: unitKind

parameters.description: Graph code for `parent`/`rootsOnly` hierarchy queries (default `command`). Ignored for the flat listing.
parameters.name: graph

parameters.description: When set, list the DIRECT children of this unit RID within `graph`. Mutually exclusive with `rootsOnly`.
parameters.name: parent

parameters.description: When true, list only the org's root units (no parent within `graph`). Mutually exclusive with `parent`.
parameters.name: rootsOnly
